description: Local experimental load-path analysis for 3D-printed STL parts, revision comparisons, visual reviews, and persistent human-guided engineering sessions.

notes: Runs as a trusted local process with access to the file paths provided by the client.
Requires Python 3.11+ and uv. No API key, model download, public website, or hosted endpoint is required.
MAKERSIM_SESSION_DIR is optional; use the same absolute path in the viewer and MCP client when overriding session storage.

clients: MCP-compatible clients that launch local stdio servers

notes: Maintainer validation on 2026-10-10: 117 Python tests passed, including a real stdio MCP client/server exchange.
The numerical solver is an experimental coarse linear-elastic preview; results do not establish failure predictions or safe working loads.
